name: Pacific Dominion
source: A mystery thriller death game. The story follows a group of fourteen high school friends, who reunite after not seeing each other for 2 years. However, the night takes a sudden turn when one of them winds up dead and their party is hijacked, forcing the remaining group to play detective in a death game with twisted rules.
